h1: Custom ImprintID Pennants for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom ImprintID pennants in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for events, schools, and promotions. Get a quote today!
introHtml: ImprintID pennants offer a durable, all-weather polyester construction that holds up to outdoor use at tailgates, parades, and trade shows. Unlike standard paper or felt pennants, these resist fading and fraying, making them a smart investment for recurring events. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery to display your logo, mascot, or event year. Bulk orders benefit from consistent color matching and fast turnaround.
heroAltText: Custom ImprintID pennants in blue and white with screen-printed logo, displayed at an outdoor event
